[[File:Trench_symbol.svg|thumb|250px|Trench's crest]]
{{Quote|The last time I saw that symbol&hellip;well, let's just say I lost a lot of good men that day.|Wullf Yularen|audio=LostALotOfGoodMen-CaM.flac|<ref name="Cat and Mouse">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>}}
This '''crest''' was used by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] as his personal symbol.

==History==
Trench was known to mark his personal [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]] with this crest. It was the crest on the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Separatist dreadnaught]] [[Invincible/Legends|''Invincible'']] that clued [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] in on the identity of his opponent at the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], having seen it before at the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]].
